verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents native SDKs for both Python and JS/TS for capturing traces (docs-5) and for querying the API (docs-49), with worked Python SDK examples (docs-63). A long-term user independently confirms official SDKs exist for Python and TypeScript (comm-7). missing for 10: detailed first-party evidence of JS/TS SDK instrumentation depth comparable to the Python examples, and a clean hands-on setup record (one user reported confusing docs and a failed instrumentation path, comm-18).
